editorial.blurb: This family-owned European cafe and bakery is a hidden gem in Lincoln Park, serving impeccably fresh pastries, desserts, and breakfast dishes made with care and creamy farm milk.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for breakfast or brunch when everything is at its freshest; order the pistachio croissant and Napoleon cake, which reviewers consistently call must-tries.

topDishes.note: Fresh and flavorful, a must-try according to reviewers
